hypothesis: With the identical tied likelihoods and NO contextual fact anywhere, no representation can do better than chance.
null_hypothesis: Some arm scores above chance without being given a fact, which would mean the trial leaks its answer through its structure.
information_note: NO arm receives any contextual fact: the phases are all zero, matched_evidence is null and there is no context feature. Every arm sees exactly the likelihoods.
expected_behaviour: Every arm near 50%. Anything materially above that is a leak, and this benchmark exists to find it.
